name: Pick up where you left off
covers: The start screen's Recent list, a package opening with the install folder and each install's settings from last time, and the sign for the same version

steps.what: the Recent list on the start screen
steps.say: NetDeploy starts afresh, and the start screen lists what was opened lately: the packages, the install folder and the deploy.json's folder.
Click Contoso.Orders-1.1.0.zip in the Recent list, to open it again
The install folder is the one it was last deployed to, ${folder.value}, without typing it again.

hover.text: The package is the same version (1.1.0).

steps.say: main is on 1.1.0 already, so the sign beside its version says the package is the same version
green started out as blue, for Production, and Environment says ${green.selection}.
Environment says ${main.selection} for main. Below the folders, the plan says Reinstall, as main is already on this version

steps.checkpoint: NetDeploy remembered what was opened and how each install was set up

checks.label: The install folder was filled in as C:\Apps\Contoso.Orders
The remembered settings are in your own settings

look: The Recent list showed the packages, C:\Apps\Contoso.Orders and the editor folder, newest first.
The payments API key box is empty: secrets are never remembered.
